Resolve survey identifiers

Source: R/surveys.R
bdhs_survey_id.Rd

Converts the many ways people refer to a BDHS round into the canonical DHS survey id (for example "BD2017DHS"). Years, year ranges, DHS survey ids, file version codes and phase-qualified codes are all accepted, so 2017, 2018, "2017-18", "BD2017DHS" and "7R" all resolve to the 2017-18 BDHS.

Usage

bdhs_survey_id(x = NULL, type = c("DHS", "SPA", "OTH"), error = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A vector of survey references (numeric or character). NULL returns every survey of the requested type.

type

Survey types to consider: any of "DHS", "SPA", "OTH".

error

If TRUE (default), unresolvable references are an error; otherwise they become NA.

Value

A character vector of DHS survey ids, the same length as x.

Details

Plain years and year ranges resolve to the main DHS round. Use the explicit id ("BD2014SPA") or a prefixed alias ("spa2014", "bmms2001") for the Service Provision Assessments and the 2001 maternal mortality survey.

Examples

bdhs_survey_id(c(2022, "2017-18", "1999-2000", "BD2014DHS", "7R"))
#> [1] "BD2022DHS" "BD2017DHS" "BD2000DHS" "BD2014DHS" "BD2017DHS"
bdhs_survey_id("spa2017")
#> [1] "BD2017SPA"
bdhs_survey_id()
#>  [1] "BD1994DHS" "BD1997DHS" "BD2000DHS" "BD2004DHS" "BD2007DHS" "BD2011DHS"
#>  [7] "BD2014DHS" "BD2017DHS" "BD2022DHS" "BD1999SPA" "BD2014SPA" "BD2017SPA"
#> [13] "BD2001OTH"
